daily_summary: 当日变更以 NVIDIA/AMD 后端性能优化与正确性修复为主：NVIDIA 侧无条件计算分布式共享内存地址（NVVM::MapaOp）以改善 ptxas 代码生成、用 cp.async 的 ignore-src 谓词替代 src-size 选择、简化 fixed-cluster program ID 生成（避免 %clusterid 的昂贵除法展开）、为 64 位整数 min/max 归约引入双 32 位 redux.sync 实现，并修复了 histogram 的 multi-CTA 语义（新增 cluster barrier 与跨 CTA 累积）。AMD 侧让 FpToFp 转换支持 GenericLinearLayout、将 dl_iterate_phdr 的 Python 回调改为原生 nanobind 实现以规避 GIL 死锁。核心 IR/Transforms 侧放宽了 BroadcastOp 的布局约束、修复了 view conversion 吸收时的 operand layout 冲突、修复 OptimizeThreadLocality 对多用途 loop result 的处理、将 shared-layout 的 toLinearLayout 分派下沉到 SharedEncodingTrait 接口、并将 unsigned mulhi 降级为宽整型乘+移位以暴露给 LLVM 优化。此外还包括 interpreter 的 round_f32_to_tf32 支持以及 Proton ROCprofiler 客户端的生命周期修复。
ascend_impact_summary: 当日变更中，多个核心 IR/Transforms 层的改动会影响 triton-ascend：(1) BroadcastOp 放宽布局约束并在 DialectInferLayoutInterface 上新增纯虚方法 verifyBroadcastOpEncoding，属于 include/triton/Dialect/Triton 与 lib/Dialect/TritonGPU 的必然影响路径，Ascend 复用 TTIR 前端且 TritonToLinalg 链以此为输入；(2) canUseResultEncoding 签名变更、OptimizeThreadLocality 修复、RemoveLayoutConversions 的 BroadcastOp 支持也会影响共享 Transform 基础设施；(3) TargetInfoBase 移除了 getMulhiFuncName 纯虚方法，但该接口 Ascend 不使用，故不影响；(4) mulhi 的 lowering 变更位于 lib/Conversion/TritonGPUToLLVM，Ascend 走 TritonToLinalg 替代路径，理论上不影响其编译链，但如果 Ascend 复用 tt.mulhi 的语义则需要关注。其余 NVIDIA/AMD 后端、Proton、测试与工具改动均为平台特定或纯测试，不影响 triton-ascend。

commits.comment: NVIDIA 后端性能优化：将分布式共享内存地址计算（mapa）从带谓词的内联 PTX 改为无条件使用 NVVM::MapaOp。原因在于 ptxas 对带谓词的 mapa 会生成额外的 SEL 指令，而地址翻译本身是可推测的（speculatable），因此将谓词通过 NVVM::MapaOp 直接表达即可，内存访问仍保留原谓词。改动集中在 third_party/nvidia/lib/TritonNVIDIAGPUToLLVM/TargetInfo.cpp 的 mapa 辅助函数、mapDShared/storeDShared/loadDShared，并更新 lit 测试断言从 'mapa.shared::cluster.u32' 改为 'nvvm.mapa'，同时在 LoadStoreOpToLLVM.cpp 增加注释。风险低：行为语义等价（地址翻译不产生副作用），但需注意 NVVM::MapaOp 必须被正确的 canonicalization/lowering 处理，否则可能在极端情况下因无条件生成 mapa 指令而引入额外寄存器压力。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。改动位于 third_party/nvidia 与 NVIDIA 专属的 TargetInfo.cpp，Ascend 不使用 NVVM::MapaOp 也不走 TritonGPUToLLVM 路径。

commits.message:
[NVIDIA] Compute distributed shared addresses unconditionally (#11794)

Compute distributed shared-memory addresses unconditionally with
`NVVM::MapaOp`, keeping the original predicates on the memory accesses.

ptxas implements `MapaOp` with a `PRMT` so predicating it creates an
extra `SEL` that just doesn't pay off. We instead emit it
unconditionally.

commits.comment: AMD 后端正确性修复：FpToFpOpConversion 在使用 GenericLinearLayout 时因尝试将其识别为 canonical LinearLayout 而触发断言，导致需要额外插入 LDS round-trip 做 layout 转换（在 MoE/GEMM epilogue 类型转换场景中经常触发）。修复方式是将 layoutTy.getElemsPerThread(shape) 替换为通用的 triton::gpu::getElemsPerThread(tensorTy)。新增 gluon 测试 test_generic_linear_fp8_cast（GFX1250 专属）以及 test/Conversion/amd/tritongpu_to_llvm_gfx1250.mlir 的两个 lit 用例（gfx1250 fp32->bf16 noncontiguous、fp32->fp8 partition_aware）。风险低：仅对 AMD 后端 fp_to_fp 转换路径改动，且切换为通用 helper 语义上更安全。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。改动位于 third_party/amd 与 AMD 专属的 ConvertFpCastOpToLLVM.cpp，Ascend 不走 FpToFpOpConversion 路径。

commits.message:
[AMD] Support GenericLinearLayout in FpToFpOp Conversion (#11791)

Previously when we do `tensor.to(dtype)` on a tensor with
`GenericLinearLayout`, the compiler tries to identify it as a canonical
LinearLayout and hit assertion.

It makes us add a specific LDS round-trip to convert layout before doing
FP conversion. Concretely, it happens in MoE/GEMM epilogue when we need
to convert the data type of accumulator who is in `GenericLinearLayout`.
This PR uses common getElemsPerThread function to avoid this issue.

commits.comment: NVIDIA 后端功能修复：使 shared memory 中指针元素的加载与存储语义一致——将指针的 load 实现为加载 i64 再 inttoptr 转换为指针（原先用 bitcast），与 store 侧策略对齐，从而让 pointer tensor 在 local_alloc/load/store/gather/scatter（IR 与 Gluon）中普遍可用。核心改动位于 third_party/nvidia/lib/TritonNVIDIAGPUToLLVM/TargetInfo.cpp 的 loadDShared：当 elemTy 为 LLVM::LLVMPointerType 时走 inttoptr，否则仍 bitcast。新增 gluon 测试 test_shared_memory_pointers（参数化 write={local_alloc,local_store,local_scatter} × read={local_load,local_gather}）以及 test/Conversion/tritongpu_to_llvm.mlir 的 @shared_memory_pointers lit 用例。风险低，但需注意该修复目前未覆盖 AMD（测试中 skipif is_hip），说明 AMD 侧另有实现。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。改动位于 third_party/nvidia 的 TargetInfo.cpp（NVIDIA 专属 TargetInfo 实现），Ascend 不使用 TargetInfoBase 及其实现。

commits.message:
[NVIDIA] Fix loading pointer elements from shared memory (#11771)

Implement loading a pointer from a shared memory buffer as loading an
i64 then convert to a pointer, consistent with the policy for shared
stores.

This makes pointer tensors work in general for all of
local_alloc/load/store/gather/scatter in both the IR and Gluon on the
NVIDIA backend.

commits.comment: 核心 IR 语义放宽：BroadcastOp 不再要求 SameOperandsAndResultEncoding，允许源与目标布局在无指令代价（不需要在线程间搬移数据、不能置换寄存器）的前提下不同。具体做法：在 DialectInferLayoutInterface 新增纯虚方法 verifyBroadcastOpEncoding(srcType, dstType)，TritonGPU 实现通过 toLinearLayout 后 resizeOutDim 并 removeZeroBasesAlongDim(kRegister) 比较来验证；Gluon 则退回严格的 encoding 相等检查。同步更新 RemoveLayoutConversions、Utility.cpp(inferSrc/DstEncoding)、InferLayoutUtils::encodingsMayVary 将 BroadcastOp 纳入可变布局算子集合，并在 TritonGPU/IR/Dialect.cpp 更新 LinearEncodingTrait::getElemsPerThread 的注释。新增 test/Gluon/auto_encoding.mlir 的 @preserve_broadcast_layouts、test/TritonGPU/canonicalize.mlir、test/TritonGPU/invalid.mlir 用例。同时 ExpandDimsOp::canonicalize 改为使用 std::nullopt loc 并在失败时静默返回 failure。风险中等，因为放宽了 IR 校验并新增了接口纯虚方法，可能影响其他 layout 传播逻辑。

commits.message:
Relax broadcast layouts (#11759)

There are multiple valid ways to broadcast a tensor with a given source
layout. Allow `BroadcastOp` to reflect that the destination layout can
be different from the source as long as no instructions have to be
generated to do the broadcast.

This is technically already expressible today by setting the source
layout to be the desired destination layout, but that is less convenient
and may not always be possible in `RemoveLayoutConversions`.

commits.comment: 核心 Transforms 正确性修复：在吸收 view conversion 时，如果 reshape 的源操作数同时位于 backward slice 中，可能被 rematerialize 为新布局，从而与已吸收的结果布局冲突。修复方式是将 canUseResultEncoding 从返回 bool 改为返回 std::optional<SmallVector<OpOperand *>>——返回需要固定布局的操作数集合（reshape 返回 src，NvidiaMma ConvertLayoutOp 返回 src），nullopt 表示不兼容；getConvertBackwardSlice 遍历这些操作数并调用 updateLayout 将源值的 encoding 固定，冲突时返回 failure 从而跳过 rematerialize。新增 test/TritonGPU/combine.mlir 的 @reshape_absorption_source_layout_conflict 用例。风险中等：signature 变更会影响所有调用 canUseResultEncoding 的代码（当前仅 getConvertBackwardSlice），语义收紧可能在未预期路径上产生 failure 而转化为保守的 layout conversion。

ascend_impact.functionality: 影响 include/triton/Dialect/TritonGPU/Transforms/Utility.h 与 lib/Dialect/TritonGPU/Transforms/Utility.cpp 中 canUseResultEncoding 的签名（bool -> std::optional<SmallVector<OpOperand*>>）。该函数属于 lib/Dialect/TritonGPU 的共享 Transform 基础设施，位于 Ascend 的必然/可能影响路径（Ascend 不走 TTGIR 但可能复用相关 Analysis/Utility）。若 Ascend 侧 pass 复用该函数需同步适配签名；若不使用则仅受头文件变更的编译影响。
ascend_impact.testing: Ascend 侧若无直接调用 canUseResultEncoding 则测试无需变更；若 Ascend 复用 layout 传播相关 pass 则需验证 reshape 吸收路径的行为。

commits.message:
Fix operand layouts when absorbing view conversions (#11758)

In the case of reshape, `canUseResultEncoding` also requires that the
reshape's source encoding does not change. However, if the source
operand is also part of the backward slice, we could end up
rematerialising it with a new layout that might be incompatible with the
result encoding that we absorbed.

To fix this, record the desired encoding for the reshape's operand, so
that we skip rematerialisation if the value requires a conflicting
encoding.

commits.comment: NVIDIA 后端性能优化：masked async copy 不再通过 select 计算 src-size（nBytes 或 0），而是直接使用 cp.async 的 ignore-src 谓词（传入 mask 的反码，约束字符 'b'），避免生成 llvm.select 与额外的寄存器/指令。改动位于 third_party/nvidia/lib/TritonNVIDIAGPUToLLVM/LoadStoreOpToLLVM.cpp 的 AsyncCopyGlobalToLocalOpConversion，lit 断言从 llvm.select 改为 llvm.xor 并检查约束 "r,l,b。同时增强 gluon 测试 test_async_copy_mbarrier，将 COPY_VEC 参数化（1/2/4）并初始化 shared memory 为 7 以验证 masked 区域被置 0。风险低：语义等价（cp.async 在 ignore-src 时填充 0），但 COPY_VEC=1/2 用例覆盖了非向量对齐路径。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。改动位于 third_party/nvidia 与 NVIDIA 专属 cp.async lowering，Ascend 不用 cp.async。

commits.message:
[NVIDIA] Use predicate operands for masked async copies (#11789)

Use the predicate `ignore-src` operand of `cp.async` for masked copies.
Pass the inverse of the copy mask directly instead of materializing a
source size of either the copy width or zero.

This improves perf of the gluon pipelined-copy tutorial by 9.6%

commits.comment: 核心 Transforms 正确性修复：OptimizeThreadLocality 的 thread-local reduction rewrite 原先假设 scf.for 结果只有单一使用者（assert(loopResult.hasOneUse())），在 loop result 被多次使用（如 arith.addf %result, %result）时会触发断言崩溃或（在无 assert 构建下）错误编译。修复方式改为使用 forOp.getTiedLoopInit/getTiedLoopResult 获取对应的 init operand 与 result index，并用 newLoop.getResult(resultIndex).replaceAllUsesWith(finalOp) 替换所有使用者，而不再假设单一 use。新增 test/TritonGPU/optimize-locality.mlir 的 @loop_result_multiple_uses 用例。风险低：属于明显的正确性修复，但涉及的 rewrite 逻辑本身较复杂。

ascend_impact.functionality: 影响 lib/Dialect/TritonGPU/Transforms/OptimizeThreadLocality.cpp，属于 lib/Dialect/TritonGPU 的共享 Transform，位于 Ascend 的可能影响路径。若 Ascend 的编译链复用该 pass（或依赖该 pass 在 TritonGPU 优化阶段的可选路径），修复多用途 loop result 的处理会影响其行为。Ascend 主链走 TritonToLinalg 不经过 TTGIR 优化，因此实际功能影响有限，但该 pass 属于共享基础设施。
ascend_impact.testing: 如上，若 Ascend 复用该 pass，建议验证多用途 loop result 场景；否则无需新增测试。

commits.message:
[OptimizeThreadLocality] Handle multi-use thread locality results (#11682)

The thread-local reduction rewrite assumed the corresponding scf.for
result had one use. This will crash valid kernels that reused it in a
build with assert, and will lead to a miscompile without asserts:
```
lib/Dialect/TritonGPU/Transforms/OptimizeThreadLocality.cpp:342: virtual void
  mlir::triton::gpu::(anonymous namespace)::TritonGPUOptimizeThreadLocalityPass::runOnOperation(): 
  Assertion `loopResult.hasOneUse()' failed.
```

For example, we trigger this when `scf`.for produces `result` that is
used as both operands in and add operation like so:

```
    %result = scf.for ... iter_args(%acc = %zero)
    ..
    %twice = arith.addf %result, %result
```

This can very easily be triggered from source code with an almost
identical pattern.

The rewrite is checking that different values inside the loop have one
use, but it forget to check that loopResult.hasOneUse() and thus misses
that it can have multiple SSA uses, which all need to be replaced.

commits.comment: 核心 IR 重构：TritonGPUDialect::toLinearLayout 原先用 dyn_cast<SwizzledSharedEncodingAttr/SharedLinearEncodingAttr/NVMMASharedEncodingAttr/AMDRotatingSharedEncodingAttr/PartitionedSharedEncodingAttr> 枚举具体共享布局类型，遇到未知布局直接 assert(0)。本 PR 改为通过 SharedEncodingTrait 的 toLinearLayout(shape) 接口分派：在 TritonGPUAttrInterfaces.td 为 SharedEncodingTrait 增加 toLinearLayout 接口方法，并为各具体 encoding 增加 extraClassDeclaration 声明；在 LinearLayoutConversions.cpp 中将原自由函数改为各 EncodingAttr 的成员方法 (SwizzledSharedEncodingAttr/AMDRotatingSharedEncodingAttr/NVMMASharedEncodingAttr/PartitionedSharedEncodingAttr::toLinearLayout)，PaddedSharedEncodingAttr 则以 report_fatal_error 显式拒绝。新增 unittest 的 OutOfTreeSharedEncodingExtensionPoint，用 StringAttr 挂 ExternalModel 作为 stand-in 验证分派确实走接口。风险中等：这是接口契约变更（新增接口方法，所有 in-tree 共享布局必须实现），但 in-tree 实现均已覆盖，对 out-of-tree 布局是解锁而非破坏。

commits.message:
[LAYOUTS] Dispatch shared-layout lowering through `SharedEncodingTrait` (#11764)

### Problem

`TritonGPUDialect::toLinearLayout` lowers a shared layout by enumerating
the concrete encodings it knows about:
`dyn_cast<Swizzled/SharedLinear/NVMMA/AMDRotating/PartitionedShared>`,
otherwise `assert(0 && "unknown layout")`, where
`PaddedSharedEncodingAttr` already lands.

Yet every one of them already implements `SharedEncodingTrait`, whose
distributed counterpart has required `toLinearLayout` for a long time.
Adding a shared layout therefore means editing that switch instead of
implementing the interface.

### Change

Dispatch through that existing abstraction:

- shared-layout lowering asks the encoding through `SharedEncodingTrait`

This is the path `DistributedEncodingTrait` and
`SharedLinearEncodingAttr` already take - it just stops the call site
from naming concrete types.
A layout core doesn't enumerate (a future in-tree encoding, or an
out-of-tree one) then lowers without touching the switch.

### Compatibility & tests

No behavior change: the conversion bodies are unchanged and a
differential over every in-tree shared encoding is identical before and
after. `OutOfTreeSharedEncodingExtensionPoint` drives the seam with a
stand-in layout, which without this change reaches the unknown-layout
assert.

-------

Same concept as in https://github.com/triton-lang/triton/pull/11025
@lezcano @peterbell10 @ThomasRaoux

commits.comment: NVIDIA 后端性能优化：llGetPid 在 numCTAs > 1 时不再使用 NVVM::ClusterIdXOp（%clusterid.x），因为 ptxas 会将其展开为对 CTA ID 做运行时 cluster 宽度的无符号除法（26 条 SASS 指令）。改为 CTA-ID 读取后右移/整除常数 numCTAs，对 X 轴为 BlockIdXOp / numCTAs 的 udiv，对 Y/Z 轴直接读 BlockIdY/BlockIdZ（因为 cluster 只沿 X 轴展开）。lit 测试相应更新为期望 llvm.mlir.constant + nvvm.read.ptx.sreg.ctaid.x + llvm.udiv，并将 profile_scratch 的 clusterid.z 改为 ctaid.z。风险低：需保证 numCTAs 为 2 的幂（cluster 沿 X 展开）时 udiv 可被优化，但常数除法对 ptxas 友好且与 cluster 语义等价（clusters launched with dimensions (numCTAs,1,1)）。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。改动位于 third_party/nvidia 的 Utility.cpp（NVIDIA 专属 TargetInfo 的 llGetPid）与 NVVM 相关 lowering，Ascend 不使用。

commits.comment: NVIDIA 后端性能优化：为 64 位整数 min/max 的全 warp 归约引入 redux.sync 实现，取代原先不可用（matchReduxKind 直接排除 width>32）。实现思路（见注释）：高 32 位以原符号性归约（signed/unsigned），低 32 位只在 high == winningHigh 的 lane 上参与 unsigned 归约（min 时非 winner 置 0xFFFFFFFF，max 时置 0），再拼回。改动位于 third_party/nvidia/lib/TritonNVIDIAGPUToLLVM/TargetInfo.cpp 的 matchReduxKind 与 warpReduce。测试包括 test/Conversion/reduce_to_llvm.mlir 的 @reduce_wide_minmax（TERNARY 变体）与 python/test/unit/language/test_core.py 中针对 int64/uint64 min/max 的 tie-breaking 边界值集（覆盖 high word 相等的低位比较、0x80000000 边界等）。风险中等：对 64 位归约的正确性要求高（signedness 语义易错），但新增了较全面的边界测试。

commits.message:
[INTERPRETER] Honor round_f32_to_tf32 on host tensor descriptor loads (#11751)

A host `TensorDescriptor` created with `round_f32_to_tf32=True` makes
the TMA unit round every f32 it loads to tf32 (round to nearest even at
10 mantissa bits, Inf and NaN left alone), and
`RewriteTensorDescriptorToPointer` inlines the same arithmetic for
targets without TMA. The interpreter copies the flag in `_init_args_hst`
and then drops it: `_implicit_cvt` builds the `TensorDescHandle` without
it and `create_descriptor_load` returns the raw bits, so under
`TRITON_INTERPRET=1` such a kernel sees different values than on the
device.

This keeps the flag on the handle and rounds in `create_descriptor_load`
when it is set and the element type is f32. Gathers reuse that path.
In-kernel `tl.make_tensor_descriptor` never rounds, matching the pointer
rewrite.

The new test covers a tie that rounds to even, a tie that rounds up, a
mantissa that carries out into the exponent, and NaN/Inf. It passes on
an RTX PRO 6000 (sm_120) and under the interpreter with this change;
without it the interpreter run fails on 13 of 16 elements.

[BACKEND][NVIDIA] Fix histogram multi-cta (#11775)

1. We need to insert a cluster barrier
2. A minor optimization for fully duplicated ctas by skipping the
cluster barrier
3. Another minor optimization by skipping accumulation of ctas that are
duplicated with others in a partially duplicated cta layout

commits.message:
[Proton][AMD] Finalize the ROCprofiler client before process teardown (#11559)

This reduces flakiness for Proton's rocprofiler-sdk shutdown.

ROCprofiler-SDK can deliver buffered profiling records during process
shutdown. Proton previously allowed its profiler state to be destroyed
before that delivery was complete, so late callbacks could access freed
state.

The resulting failures were timing- and allocator-dependent: affected
processes could exit successfully, hang during teardown, report heap
corruption, or terminate with `SIGSEGV`/`SIGABRT` after profiling had
otherwise completed successfully. Explicit `proton.finalize()` often hid
the issue by draining pending records earlier, but process exit without
explicit finalization remained unsafe.

This change makes Proton’s lifetime agree with the ROCprofiler-SDK
client lifecycle: all callbacks required during terminal SDK shutdown
complete while their Proton destinations remain valid. It also adds
subprocess coverage for SDK-driven shutdown, using heap perturbation to
reliably expose stale- state access that would otherwise depend on
allocator reuse and timing.

The included regression test runs profiling in a subprocess, queues GPU
work, and deliberately exits without synchronizing the device or calling
`proton.finalize()`. This leaves rocprofiler-sdk responsible for
completing outstanding work and delivering pending callbacks during its
process-exit shutdown sequence, which is where the lifetime bug occurs.

The test also enables glibc’s `MALLOC_PERTURB_` debugging behavior.
Without it, freed Proton storage often retains enough of its previous
contents for the invalid callback to appear to work, making the bug
highly sensitive to allocator reuse and timing. I initially used a
simpler test that reproduced the original `SIGSEGV`, but only once
across many runs, so it was not reliable enough to demonstrate that the
fix changed the behavior rather than merely getting lucky.

With heap perturbation, freed allocations are overwritten with a
recognizable byte pattern, making callbacks into destroyed Proton state
consistently fail instead of accidentally succeeding. Running the test
for 10 subprocesses without the fix in this PR resulted in 10 failures
(non-termination during teardown, at least not within a generous
timeout). With the fix, 60 out of 60 runs exited successfully (well
under timeout).

commits.message:
[AMD] Avoid GIL deadlock during HIP library lookup (#11265)

## Summary

Loading of AOT cache is thread-unsafe on amd. 
Avoid a ROCm startup deadlock by replacing Triton’s dl_iterate_phdr
python
callback with a fully native callback compiled into the existing
triton._C.libtriton.amd extension.

This avoids entering Python while glibc holds its dynamic-loader lock
without
introducing a separately runtime-compiled helper.

Another approach would be to add native callback that is compiled in
runtime, but this seems a b it cleaner.

## Root cause

Parallel AOT-cache deserialization can create an ABBA deadlock between
Python's GIL and glibc's dynamic linker lock `_dl_load_write_lock`:

- Triton calls `dl_iterate_phdr()` through `ctypes.CDLL`, which releases
the
GIL for the native call. glibc acquires `_dl_load_write_lock` and
invokes
Triton's `ctypes.CFUNCTYPE` callback while still holding it. Entering
that
  Python callback requires reacquiring the GIL.

- Concurrently, another Python thread calls `hipModuleLoadData()`
through a
  native extension that has not released the GIL. HIP/HSA calls
`dl_iterate_phdr()` and blocks on `_dl_load_write_lock` while that
thread
  still owns the GIL.

This leaves one thread holding `_dl_load_write_lock` and waiting for the
GIL,
and the other holding the GIL and waiting for `_dl_load_write_lock` (as
shown in gdb and pyspy trace)

意图与实现：(1) third_party/nvidia/lib/TritonNVIDIAGPUToLLVM/LoadStoreOpToLLVM.cpp 新增 isDefaultCachePolicy()，用于判断 cache policy 是否等价于默认策略（modifier 为 NONE 或等于对应默认 CA/WB，legacy eviction 为 NORMAL，detailed policy 的 L1/L2 均为 NONE 或 EVICT_NORMAL 且 L2 prefetch 为空且 L2 fraction==1.0）；当 load 无 mask 且 policy 默认、store 无 threadPred 且无 llMask 且 policy 默认时，直接发射 LLVM b.load/b.store（向量情形经 vec_ty/packLLVector 处理），跳过内联 PTX 路径，让 LLVM 自行优化寻址与整数扩展；非默认策略仍走原 PTX ASM 路径。(2) 修复 createCachePolicy 中 fractional L2 字面量：若格式化结果不含 '.'/'e'/'E'（例如整数 1），则追加 '.0'，保证 PTX 浮点字面量合法。(3) 将两处 valueElemNBits/dtsize 的 std::max(8,...)/std::max(1,...) 夹取移除，因为类型已被 verifier 保证 >=8bit。(4) lib/Dialect/Triton/IR/Ops.cpp 把原 verifyAtomicLoadStoreType 重命名并提升为通用 verifyLoadStoreType，并接入 LoadOp::verify/StoreOp::verify，禁止 i1/i4 等 sub-byte 及非 int/float 元素。

风险与影响：本变更是 NVIDIA 后端访存 codegen 的行为性变更，直接影响生成的 PTX/最终 SASS。对依赖 cache modifier 的路径，测试相应放宽/调整（.ca/.wb 默认不再单独断言）。verifyLoadStoreType 收紧是潜在的兼容性风险：任何此前能通过 verifier 的 sub-byte 访存（如 !tt.ptr<i1>）现在会报错，test/TritonGPU/combine.mlir 中 assert 用例已从 i1 改为 i8+cmpi。移除 max(8,...) 夹取后，若有路径绕过了 verifier（如直接由 pass 构造 IR），可能产生 0 字节/错误宽度访问，需依赖 verifier 兜底。整体属于 performance + refactor 混合，风险中等偏低。

[NVIDIA] Lower unpredicated global loads and stores through LLVM (#11770)

Emit LLVM loads and stores for unpredicated global accesses with
default-equivalent cache policies so LLVM can optimize addressing and
integer extensions. Ensure integral L2 cache-policy fractions use PTX
floating-point literals.
